name: zscaler-terraform-skills
description: Agent skills that teach OpenAI Codex how to write correct Terraform HCL for the Zscaler providers (ZPA, ZIA, ZTC, ZCC) and how to structure / operate Zscaler-Terraform repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Terraform HCL guidance for the Zscaler providers (ZPA, ZIA, ZTC, ZCC) + Zscaler-Terraform engineering best practices.
interface.longDescription: Diagnose-first guidance for writing, reviewing, and debugging Terraform HCL that uses the Zscaler providers. Five composable skills cover provider correctness per product (ZPA, ZIA, ZTC, ZCC) and cross-cutting engineering discipline (state organization for microtenants, CI/CD with the Zscaler activation step, OIDC against Zidentity, secret handling, testing strategy, modules, naming, anti-patterns).
